content: {"rule":"K-C","applies":"yes","applies_why":"The judge text decides a collision over Matthew 1:20 by noting each side's answer, so it is doing the kind of chain-versus-chain assessment K-C governs.","verdict":"BREACH","quote":"D2 vs C1 (Matthew 1:20): UNDERDETERMINED -- Challenger answered the conception agency as covenant presence in [DR3] and defender answered the physical source in the womb in [CR2] and [CR3].","rule_words":"When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.","room":"none","why":"The judge calls the point underdetermined by citing each side's answer but does not weigh chain against chain by footing, leaving the required K-C method undone."}
